column3: “charge” renders “command” (mishmeret, what is to be kept); “always” renders “all the days.”
NASB supplies “I am not speaking with”; the Hebrew sentence is broken off after “not with your children.” “sons” renders “children,” and “discipline” renders “training.”
“the Red Sea” renders “the Sea of Reeds”; “engulf them” renders “flow over their faces,” and “completely destroyed them” renders “destroyed them until this day.”
“every living thing that followed them” renders “all the substance at their feet.”
“with your foot” follows the Hebrew; “vegetable garden” renders “garden of vegetables.”
“listen obediently” renders the doubled verb “surely obey”; “soul” renders “being.”
“He will give” differs from the Hebrew “I will give”; “the early and late rain” renders “autumn rain and spring rain.”
“He will give” differs from the Hebrew “I will give.”
“impress” renders “put”; “frontals on your forehead” renders “marks between your eyes.”
“as long as the heavens remain above the earth” renders “like the days of the heavens above the earth.”
“are careful to keep” renders the doubled verb “surely keep”; “hold fast” renders “cleave.”
NASB reads “from the wilderness to Lebanon”; the Hebrew is “from the wilderness and the Lebanon.”
“west of the way toward the sunset” renders “behind the way of the setting of the sun”; “oaks” renders “great trees” (terebinths).
